orgName: Las Vegas Convention and Visitors Authority (LVCVA) - 'Las Vegas' patch

source.name: MLB Trade Rumors - A's Announce Las Vegas Jersey Patch Sponsorship
source.note: Value and term from The Athletic, as reported here. The article dates the third payment to 2028 while the club and the Las Vegas Review-Journal call it the 2027 season, so `to` is left null.
source.quote: the deal will pay the A's $8.25MM over the next three seasons: $2.5MM this season, $2.75MM next year, and $3MM in 2028

note: Jersey patch, worn on the sleeve; the club's own announcement says all home, road and alternate jerseys, regular season and postseason.
